questions.question: Differentiate between DNA,RNA and protein.
questions.solution_html:
• Introduction (2 marks): sequence alignment is a way of arranging the sequences of DNA
  • RNA, or protein to identify regions of similarity. Global alignment: Aligns the entire length
  • of both sequences, usually done for sequences of high similarity. Local alignment: Done
  • to identify local regions of similarity/ conserved regions.
  • Difference (3 marks): Global alignment: Tries to align entire sequence, Align all letters
  • from query and target, Suitable for closely related sequences. A general Global Alignment
  • Method is NEEDLEMAN - WUNSCH. Local alignment: Align regions having highest
  • similarities, Align substring of target with substring of query, Suitable for more divergent
  • sequences, a general Local Alignment Method is SMITH-WATERMAN
questions.final_answer: sequences, a general Local Alignment Method is SMITH-WATERMAN
